A 7-ODE continuous-time dynamical system predicts platelet trajectories over cycles 2-4 on the independent n=19 temporal validation cohort (VPC match in Fig. 3B; nadir CCC 0.91, R^2 0.84, RMSE 22 vs 52 G/L population-only).

Both ODE structural equations (7-ODE Friberg-type myelosuppression system) and population/individual random-effect parameters (PLT0, ktr, slope, gamma, omega_*, b; Supp. Table 6D p. 34, Supp. Fig. 6 p. 27) are discovered and estimated from data via SAEM and per-patient Bayesian MAP/Metropolis-Hastings calibration. Under project rules, identified mechanistic transition parameters satisfy dynamics.learned_hybrid.
Dose drives the model, and forecasts for the given schedule were checked, with alternative schedules not validated.
Posterior draws give predictive intervals that contained the observed nadir.
The structure is a semi-mechanistic myelosuppression model.

evidence_fragments.content: Population parameter estimates of the APOD-discovered model for each real cohort of Figures 2 and 3, with relative standard errors (RSE) and 95% confidence intervals (CI) from the stochastic approximation of the Fisher information matrix. One sub-table per cohort: (A) docetaxel plasma pharmacokinetics (PK), three-compartment intravenous disposition; (B) untreated breast-cancer xenograft tumor dynamics (TD), hyper-Gompertz growth law; (C) the coupled pharmacokinetic–tumor-dynamic (PK-TD) polymer-prodrug cohort, logistic growth with a concentration-threshold kill term driven by an effect compartment; (D) platelet dynamics (pharmacodynamics, PD) under radioligand therapy.
evidence_fragments.extractor_or_reviewer: Phase E repair reviewer (direct text and page-image verification)

evidence_fragments.content: Every patient received a fixed activity of 7,400 MBq per cycle, for up to four cycles eight weeks apart. The nadir is the lowest platelet count recorded for a patient over the whole treatment course. Grades follow the Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events (CTCAE) v5.0 for platelet count decreased, taking 150 G/L as the lower limit of normal: grade 1, 75–150 G/L; grade 2, 50–75 G/L; grade 3, 25–50 G/L; grade 4, below 25 G/L; no patient in either cohort reached grade 3.

capability_assessments.rationale: Discovered 7-ODE population myelosuppression model with persistent compartment states (0019), continuous-time dynamics (0041), data-discovered structure and SAEM/Bayesian-identified transition parameters (0042), and dose-driven action conditioning (0043) whose cycle-1-calibrated future platelet nadir forecasts were temporally validated on n=19 independent patients (0053; CCC 0.91, R^2 0.84; L2). L3 is not established because all observed patients received fixed 7,400 MBq/cycle (Supp. Table 7) and alternative-schedule simulations were never compared against observed outcomes. The APOD discovery agent itself is a discovery system rather than a world model.

gate_assessments.rationale: Cohort provenance, date cutoffs (Apr 2022-Oct 2024 vs Oct 2024-Nov 2025), units, ethics approval (PIXIRIV-IPC 2023-034), and GDPR handling are documented (0001), and an independent temporal cohort of 19 patients is held out from discovery and population parameter estimation with frozen population priors (0010).

Future cycles 2-4 platelet trajectories and observed nadirs are forecasted from cycle-1 calibration on n=19 independent temporal test patients, outperforming the population-only baseline (R^2 0.84 vs 0.06, CCC 0.91, RMSE 22 vs 52 G/L, 100% 90% PI coverage; 0019, 0041, 0053). Per-timepoint horizon breakdown remains unresolved in G03, and unvalidated alternative dosing schedules remain unresolved in G05.
Forecasts over later cycles are described, with only the nadir scored, so evidence per prediction time is not reported in the text read.
Alternative schedules are simulated for one patient and averages for 19, with no validation and no support analysis.

legacy_cells.B: APOD: reasoning-guided agentic population ordinary differential equation discovery for pharmacological digital twins
legacy_cells.C: Ferrara, Romain, Soucail, Martin, Gertner, Victor, Moussali, Adil, Cocquebert, Joris, Oziel-Taieb, Sandrine, et al.
legacy_cells.O: Treatment-induced thrombocytopenia during [177Lu]Lu-DOTATATE therapy for metastatic neuroendocrine tumors; also PK and tumor-growth dynamics
legacy_cells.S: Can a population ODE model discovered from first-cycle platelet measurements predict later platelet nadirs and compare simulated radioligand-therapy schedules?
legacy_cells.V: Assess platelet-toxicity risk relevant to dose reduction or treatment interruption
legacy_cells.AI: Longitudinal platelet counts; administered radioligand dose and treatment schedule; across the broader evaluation, drug concentrations and tumor-volume measurements
legacy_cells.AS: Seven ODE state variables in the platelet model: Ac, Prol, Tr1–Tr5, and PLT
legacy_cells.AT: Bayesian individualisation: estimate patient-specific parameters from cycle-1 observations using the training-population parameter distribution as prior; posterior sampling for forecast intervals
legacy_cells.AZ: Interpretable named ODE states and parameters, including drug proxy, proliferating pool, five maturation compartments, circulating platelets, transit rate, and drug-effect slope
legacy_cells.BD: Administered activity/dose in MBq; cycle timing; omission of a cycle; later-cycle dose reduction to 3,700 MBq; four-week delay
legacy_cells.BL: Platelet dynamics in days; planned treatment cycles eight weeks apart
legacy_cells.BN: Mechanistic compartmental myelosuppression model: drug-effect term, proliferating pool with feedback, and five transit/maturation compartments
legacy_cells.BS: Predicted platelet-count trajectories and platelet nadirs; simulated trajectories under alternate dosing schedules
legacy_cells.BT: Platelet-count trajectory/nadir prediction and grade-1 thrombocytopenia threshold flag from the predicted nadir
legacy_cells.BV: Population parameters estimated with SAEM; individual parameters estimated by maximum-a-posteriori Bayesian estimation; posterior draws propagated for predictive intervals
legacy_cells.CG: 400 retained posterior draws per patient after 300 burn-in iterations, thinned by two
legacy_cells.CR: 90% predictive-interval empirical coverage: observed nadir was contained for all 19 independent test-cohort patients; nadir concordance correlation 0.91 (95% CI 0.79–0.96), R² 0.84, RMSE 22 G/L, MAE 17 G/L (95% CI 12–23)
legacy_cells.CX: Alternative-schedule simulations were not validated against observations
legacy_cells.DB: Three named agent roles: Reflexion Agent (proposes/refines models), Model Writer (generates Mlxtran ODEs), and Evaluation Agent (assesses fit, identifiability, and plausibility)
legacy_cells.DC: Iterative context includes prior candidate results and aggregated diagnostic summaries; no individual-level records are passed to the LLM
legacy_cells.DN: Synthetic PK and tumor-dynamics benchmarks; docetaxel PK; ciclosporine PK; [177Lu]Lu-DOTATATE renal-handling cohort; breast-cancer xenograft tumor dynamics; syngeneic lung tumor cohort; paclitaxel polymer-prodrug PK-TD cohort; COMPORIV platelet cohort
legacy_cells.DQ: Synthetic: 10 PK datasets (60 virtual subjects each) and 5 tumor-dynamics datasets (30 each). Real cohorts: docetaxel 34 patients; ciclosporine 14; renal handling 10; breast tumor 66 mice; lung tumor 20 mice; paclitaxel PK-TD 106 mice; COMPORIV platelet training 44 patients and independent test 19 patients
legacy_cells.DY: First-cycle forecasts of later-cycle nadirs in 19 patients: 90% intervals covered all observed nadirs; CCC 0.91, R² 0.84, Spearman 0.88, RMSE 22 G/L, MAE 17 G/L
legacy_cells.EA: Real-cohort fit and visual predictive checks were assessed; for the independent platelet cohort, observed nadirs were within the 90% prediction intervals in all 19 patients
legacy_cells.EB: For the test patient whose standard schedule predicted grade-1 toxicity, halving activity from cycle 2 changed predicted toxicity probability from 0.94 to 0.59, while omitting one cycle left it at 0.93; across 19 patients predicted nadir increased by 26 G/L with halved activity, 7 G/L with an omitted cycle, and 2 G/L with a four-week delay
legacy_cells.EC: At the grade-1 threshold, the first-cycle forecast flagged 11 of 12 patients who later developed thrombocytopenia and cleared 5 of 7 who did not
legacy_cells.EG: Synthetic benchmark: 96% pooled structural recovery; median APOD run 4.1 min versus 10.8 min for the BIC-only ablation; median run was 24 times faster than library search on PK and 4.5 times faster on tumor-dynamics scenarios
legacy_cells.EI: Compared with mlxModelFinder: APOD recovered generating structures in 94% of synthetic PK and 100% of synthetic tumor-dynamics runs versus 98% and 80%, respectively; APOD median runs were 24-fold and 4.5-fold faster. BIC-only ablation reduced pooled structural recovery from 96% to 88% and took median 10.8 versus 4.1 minutes
legacy_cells.EK: Reasoning-layer ablation: replacing multi-diagnostic reasoning with BICc-only selection reduced structural recovery from 96% to 88%, exact random-effect recovery from 70% to 59%, and increased median runtime from 4.1 to 10.8 minutes
legacy_cells.EL: For locally hosted open-weight LLM backends, 32%–75% of proposals could not be estimated because generated code was invalid; open-weight backends had lower structural recovery than the reference model
legacy_cells.EO: Individual-level records were kept local and not sent to the LLM; only aggregate, non-identifying diagnostics were provided. Patient data were pseudonymised and processed in a private institutional repository under GDPR
legacy_cells.ER: Institut Paoli-Calmettes institutional ethics committee approval PIXIRIV-IPC 2023-034; informed-consent waiver
legacy_cells.FB: Shared population-level mechanistic ODE state with between-subject parameter variability; platelet model state comprises a dose-driven drug proxy, proliferating progenitor pool, five maturation compartments, and circulating platelet count
legacy_cells.FL: Dataset structure and aggregate diagnostics plus task prompt → Reflexion Agent proposes ODE structures and between-subject variability → Model Writer encodes candidates in Mlxtran → local Monolix/SAEM fits parameters → Evaluation Agent reviews fit, identifiability, plausibility, and residual diagnostics → iterative refinement/model selection → selected ODE and forecasts/reports; no evaluated planner
legacy_cells.FM: Introduces a reasoning-guided LLM agent for open-structure population ODE discovery, including between-subject variability; demonstrates synthetic structural recovery, applications to real PK and tumor-dynamics cohorts, and first-cycle platelet-toxicity forecasting with alternate-schedule simulation
legacy_cells.FN: Synthetic ground-truth structure recovered in 96% of pooled runs; on 19 independent platelet-test patients, 90% intervals contained every observed nadir, with CCC 0.91 and RMSE 22 G/L; simulated halving of later-cycle activity increased predicted nadir by 26 G/L across patients
legacy_cells.FO: APOD does not model covariates, limiting prediction for patients without on-treatment measurements; clinical validation was temporal rather than multi-centre; observed toxicity was moderate and prediction of severe dose-limiting events remains unestablished; discovery in domains without mechanistic descriptions remains untested
legacy_cells.FP: Authors identify incorporating informative covariates into discovery, testing on higher-toxicity cohorts and prospectively evaluating predicted schedule effects, and testing structure discovery in domains lacking mechanistic descriptions as next steps
legacy_cells.FQ: Existing automated population ODE discovery methods either restrict candidate structures to predefined libraries or do not support population-level inference from sparse, noisy, heterogeneous observations; earlier LLM agents were described as lacking population inference and broader validation
legacy_cells.FR: The evidence supports population ODE discovery and retrospective/temporal forecast performance, not prospective clinical benefit or treatment-effect identification. Alternative dosing schedules are model simulations explicitly not compared with observations; validation was at one centre and severe toxicity prediction remains unestablished; no optimizer or closed-loop clinical planning was evaluated
legacy_cells.FS: Reviewer mapping: M3 Belief-state service; M4 Action service; M5 Dynamics adapter; M6 Rollout service; M7 Outcome & causal layer
legacy_cells.FT: Reviewer lesson: Pass the paper’s specified action and time context explicitly into the state-transition interface; preserve the boundary between predictive action sensitivity and identified intervention effects.

limitations: All 35 PDF pages (main text, methods, references, and supplementary pages 18-35) were read as extracted text. All 6 main figure/table pages (3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 10: Tables 1-3, Figures 1-3) were visually inspected via rendered PNGs during Phase E repair; supplementary figures/tables on pages 21-35 were reviewed via extracted text.

All patients in both the COMPORIV training (n=44) and temporal test (n=19) cohorts received a fixed activity of 7,400 MBq/cycle and none reached CTCAE grade 3-4 thrombocytopenia (Supplementary Table 7, p. 35); counterfactual reduced-dose and omitted-cycle simulations remain unvalidated against clinical outcomes.
The temporal validation cohort is small (n=19) and from the same centre (Institut Paoli-Calmettes), so external multi-site generalization is untested.
The legacy row was read from the root workbook (read only). Saved API drafts for B072 were not opened. The GitLab repositories stated in the paper were not inspected.
Schema validity and quote occurrence do not establish semantic correctness. No independent human review.
notes: APOD is a reflexion agent using Claude Opus 4.5 that proposes Mlxtran population ODE models, estimated by Monolix, and returns only aggregate diagnostics. Synthetic recovery is 96 percent over all runs, 2.5 to 40 times faster than a library search. A discovered Friberg-type platelet model, individualised on cycle 1 for 19 later patients, predicts nadir with concordance 0.91 and MAE 17 G/L. Classified L2, supporting component by a strict V11 reading. Source points: single centre temporal validation, wide intervals with 19 patients, unvalidated schedule simulations, one backbone for all real experiments, code claimed.
